# Security Policy

## Supported versions

| Version | Supported |
|---|---|
| 0.3.x | ✅ |
| 0.2.x | ✅ |
| 0.1.x | ⚠️ critical fixes only |

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities.

Email: **koraydemirmc@gmail.com**

Include:

- Description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce
- Affected version
- Suggested fix (if any)

We aim to respond within 48 hours and ship a fix within 7 days for critical issues.

## Out of scope

- Vulnerabilities in third-party dependencies (report upstream)
- Vulnerabilities in the user's scanned project
- Theoretical issues without a concrete exploit path
